title: FIFA World Cup 2026: Here’s How to Watch Spanish-Language Broadcast Matches Live Online
summary: Livestream your favorite Latin American teams during the international fútbol tournament in Spanish without cable for free.
contentText:

Beginning Thursday (June 11), Mexico, United States and Canada are all hosting matches during the 2026 FIFA World Cup . World-class fútbol players and top-ranked national teams, like Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Uruguay, Ecuador and Paraguay, as well as other nations, gather together to compete for a chance to hoist the FIFA World Cup Trophy on the pitch.

For the 23rd edition, 16 cities in North America, like Mexico City, Guadalajara, Monterrey, Los Angeles, New York City and others, host matches throughout the fútbol tournament.

Watch 2026 FIFA World Cup in Spanish with DirectV

How to Watch 2026 FIFA World Cup in Spanish Online, At a Glance:

- Date: June 11-July 19

- Broadcast Channels: Telemundo and Universo

- Streaming: DirecTV , Peacock , Hulu + Live TV , Sling TV , ExpressVPN

When Does 2026 FIFA World Cup Start ?

FIFA World Cup begins on Thursday (June 11), while it ends on Sunday (July 19) with the final match. Matches for the fútbol tournament can be found live on Telemundo and Universo for Spanish-language broadcasts. Check out a full fixture of matches and start times here .

Where to Watch 2026 FIFA World Cup in Spanish Online for Free

DirecTV

Get Five-Day Free Trial

Watch for free with a five-day free trial .

To watch World Cup matches in Spanish, go with DirecTV, which offers the “ MiEspañol Genre Pack ” available for $29.99 per month for the first two months of service ($34.99 per month afterward). The genre pack includes more than 20 Spanish-language channels, like Telemundo and Universo.

Peacock

Get Peacock Premium

The official streamer for Telemundo and Universo.

Peacock is the official streaming home to World Cup Spanish-language broadcasts in the United States. The service offers the Premium Plan , which is priced at $10.99 per month, or the Premium Plus Plan , which goes for $16.99 per month. Both plans offer Telemundo and Universo for World Cup matches.

Want to save some money with Peacock? The service has annual plans available too, so you can get 17% off your yearly bill. If you pay $109.99 per year, or $169.99 per year, up front, then you can livestream Peacock Premium , or Peacock Premium Plus , respectively, at a lower cost. And aside from World Cup, the streaming service also grants you access to more live sports from Premiere League, MLB, WNBA, NBA, NFL and other pro leagues.

Meanwhile, Peacock doesn’t offer a free trial. However, you can get 30 days of access to Peacock for as low as $1 with a subscription to Walmart+ . Streaming access is one of the retailer’s benefits and perks. Learn more about Walmart+ and Peacock here .

ExpressVPN

Get ExpressVPN

If you want to watch international broadcasts of World Cup matches in the United States, then a subscription to ExpressVPN is a must. It’s a virtual private network that allows you to watch other nations’ TV broadcasts, even if you’re not in the same country. The service acts like a key to international broadcasts geo-locks.

So if you’re Argentinian, but you live in Los Angeles, then you can still watch Argentina National Team matches on Telefe and TV Pública in California. Here’s how it works: Just fire up the ExpressVPN app on your a phone, tablet, web browser, laptop or streaming device, set your location to Argentina, and then launch the Telefe website or TV Pública app to start watching matches.

With prices starting at $2.79 per month for 28 months, you can watch content from more than 100 countries from all around the world. Learn more about ExpressVPN here .

Hulu + Live TV

Get three-day free trial

Hulu + Live TV comes with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited at no additional cost.

For Telemundo, you can watch the network with a subscription to Hulu + Live TV , which offers a three-day free trial to try out the service before you commit. Once the free trial is finished, regular subscription fees starts at $89.99 per month. And at no additional cost, Hulu + Live TV is bundled with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited to watch more originals, live sporting events and other programming.

Sling TV

Get Sling Blue

Sling Latino comes with 20+ channels.

While Sling TV doesn’t have Telemundo as one of its network offerings, it does have Universo with the Sling Latino plan. It goes for $10 per month and comes with more than 20 Spanish-language broadcast channels too. Please note: Prices and channel availability depends on your local TV market. You can learn more about Sling TV here .

Who Is Performing During 2026 FIFA World Cup?

The opening ceremony of the World Cup is spread across two days, Tuesday (June 11) in Estadio Azteca in Mexico and Wednesday (June 12) in Los Angeles Stadium in the United States and Toronto Stadium in Canada.

For Mexico, Alejandro Fernández, Belinda, Danny Ocean, J Balvin, Lila Downs and others are scheduled to perform, while Katy Perry, Future, Anitta, LISA, Rema and Tyla are set for the United States and Alanis Morissette, Alessia Cara, Elyanna, Jessie Reyez, Michael Bublé and others are performing in Canada.

And on Sunday (July 19), Madonna, Shakira with Burna Boy , and BTS are expected to perform during the halftime show of the World Cup Final at New York New Jersey Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey.

But until then, the 2026 FIFA World Cup is available to watch in Spanish on Telemundo and Universo, via DirecTV , beginning on Thursday (June 11). In the meantime, you can find how to watch matches with English-language broadcasts here .
